notes: Rod minigame coverage: Xorcist (static-meter supercharge policy), RecordBreaker (notch-vs-target rotation timing via right-click), Maelstrom (charge-aware release gate), and a rewritten Pinion's Aria that enumerates live notes instead of looking them up by name. Fixes the update channel: the checker now queries every manifest source and keeps the highest version instead of stopping at the first response, so a stale CDN edge can no longer mask a published release. raw.githubusercontent.com lags a publish by minutes and jsDelivr's purge endpoint is rate limited, which together made the app report up to date against a manifest that no longer existed. Also mirrors the Lua bundle into build/bin/lua so packaging can no longer ship a stale copy.
